```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(stargazer)
library(margins)
library(ggplot2)
library(WVPlots)
library(stargazer)
library(gapminder)
library(grid)
```

![]()

------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
gapminder |>
  filter(year == 2007) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = gdpPercap, 
             y = lifeExp,
             color = continent)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8,
             size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(se = F) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1000, 10000, 50000),
    labels = scales::dollar
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "GDP per capita",
    y = "Life expectancy",
    color = "Continent")
```

```{r}
gapminder |>
  filter(year == 2007) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = gdpPercap, 
             y = lifeExp,
             color = continent)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8,
             size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(se = F) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 20000)),
    labels = scales::dollar
)+
  labs(
    x = "GDP per capita",
    y = "Life expectancy",
    color = "Continent")
```

```{r}
gapminder |>
  filter(year == 2007) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = gdpPercap, 
             y = lifeExp,
             color = continent)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8,
             size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(se = F) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1000, 10000, 50000),
    labels = label_dollar() )+  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  labs(
    x = "GDP per capita",
    y = "Life expectancy",
    color = "Continent")
```

```{r}
gapminder |>
  filter(year <= 2007, year >= 1990) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = gdpPercap, 
             y = lifeExp,
             color = factor(year)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8,
             size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(se = F) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1000, 10000, 50000),
    labels = ... + ... + scale_color_viridis_c()
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "GDP per capita",
    y = "Life expectancy",
    color = "Continent")
```

```{r}
gapminder |>
  filter(year == 2007) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = gdpPercap, 
             y = lifeExp, 
             color = continent)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Africa" = "#1b9e77",
      "Americas" = "#d95f02",
      "Asia" = "#7570b3",
      "Europe" = "#e7298a",
      "Oceania" = "#66a61e"
    )
  )
```

# Guides()

```{r}
gapminder |>
  filter(year == 2007) |>
  ggplot(aes(gdpPercap, lifeExp, 
             color = continent)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  guides(color = "none")
```

```{r}
gapminder |>
  filter(year == 2007) |>
  ggplot(aes(gdpPercap, lifeExp, 
             color = continent)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
gapminder |>
  filter(year == 2007) |>
  ggplot(aes(gdpPercap, lifeExp, 
             color = pop)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  guides(
    color = 
      guide_colorbar(
        barheight = unit(4, "cm")))
```

```{r}
gapminder |>
  filter(year == 2007) |>
  ggplot(aes(gdpPercap, lifeExp, color = continent)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE))
```

```{r}
gapminder |>
  filter(year == 2007) |>
  ggplot(aes(gdpPercap, lifeExp, 
             color = continent, 
             size = pop)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(order = 1),
    size  = guide_legend(order = 2)
  )
```

```{r}
gapminder |>
  filter(year == 2007) |>
  ggplot(aes(gdpPercap, lifeExp, 
             color = continent)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, 
             size = 3) +
  guides(
    color = 
      guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(alpha = 1)))
```

# Theme()

```{r}
p <- gapminder |>
  filter(year == 2007) |>
  ggplot(aes(gdpPercap, lifeExp, 
             color = continent)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_x_log10()

p + theme_minimal()
p + theme_classic()
p + theme_light()
p + hrbrthemes::theme_ipsum()
p + ggthemes::theme_fivethirtyeight()
```

```{r}
p <- gapminder |>
  filter(year == 2007) |>
  ggplot(aes(gdpPercap, lifeExp, 
             color = continent)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_x_log10() + 
  theme(legend.position = "top")
p
```

```{r}
p +
  labs(title = "GPD vs. Life EXpectancy")
theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.title=
        element_text()
```

```{r}
gapminder |>
  filter(year == 2007) |>
  ggplot(aes(gdpPercap, lifeExp, 
             color = continent)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::dollar) +
  labs(
    title = "Life expectancy vs GDP per capita (2007)",
    subtitle = "Log x-axis; color = continent",
    x = "GDP per capita (log scale)",
    y = "Life expectancy",
    color = "Continent",
    caption = "Source: gapminder"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold.italic"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

# Classwork 7

```{r}
titanic_details <- read_csv("https://bcdanl.github.io/data/titanic_details.csv")

rmarkdown::paged_table(titanic_details)
```

# Question 1

```{r}
ggplot(titanic_details, 
       aes(x = age, y = fare, 
           color = class)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1000, 10000, 50000),
    labels = scales::dollar
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Age",
    y = "Fare",
    color = "Class")
```

# Question 2

```{r}
ggplot(titanic_details, 
       aes(x = age, y = fare, 
           color = class)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1000, 10000, 50000),
    labels = scales::dollar
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Age",
    y = "Fare",
    color = "Class")  +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
    guides(color = "none")
```

# Question 3

```{r}
ggplot(titanic_details, 
       aes(x = age, y = fare, 
           color = class)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1000, 10000, 50000),
    labels = scales::dollar
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Age",
    y = "Fare",
    color = "Class")  +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top")
  plot.tite = element_text(color =   "purple")
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45)
  axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold")
```

```{r}
# install.packages("socviz")
organdata <- socviz::organdata

organdata |> 
  rmarkdown::paged_table()
```

# Part 2

```{r}
p <- ggplot(data = organdata,
            mapping = aes(x = roads,
                          y = donors,
                          color = world))
p + geom_point()
```

# Question 4

```{r}
p <- ggplot(data = organdata,
            mapping = aes(x = roads,
                          y = donors,
                          color = world))
p + geom_point() +
    scale_x_log10()+
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(5, 15, 25),
    labels = c("Fivel, Fifteen, Twenty Five")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "roads",
    y = "Fivel, Fifteen, Twenty Five",
    color = "world")
guides(
  color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))
)
```

# Part 3

```{r}
brexit <- read_csv('https://bcdanl.github.io/data/brexit.csv')
```

# Question 5

```{r}
ggplot(
  data = brexit,
  mapping = 
    aes( y = opinion, fill = opinion)
)+
geom_bar()+
  facet_wrap(~ region)+
    scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Don't know" = "gray",
      "Right" = "#67a9cf",
      "Wrong" = "#ef8a62"
      ))
```
